text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The Prime Ministers of Hungary, Austria and Slovakia, Gyula Horn, Franz Vranitzky and Vladimir Meciar, will meet on Monday in the western Slovak spa town of Piestany.

- Heavy engineering company ZTS Sabinov plans to launch a five-year, 100 million crown bond issue in December. The publicly traded bond will carry an annual fixed rate of 14 percent in the first year, and a coupon of BRIBOR plus 0.95 percent in the second year.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The modernisation of Slovakia's pharmaceutical and chemical industry will require investments of 55 to 60 billion crowns over the next four years.
- Slovak sugar production is expected to total around 190,000 tonnes this year, which should fully cover domestic consumption.

- Slovakia's largest celullose and paper producer SCP Ruzomberok posted gross profit of around 480 million crowns in the first nine months of this year. SCP said its full year profit should total about 727 milion crowns.
- Italy's Fiat has so far this year sold about 6,000 cars in Slovakia, representing about seven percent of the country's entire market.

SME - The state fund of market regulation will sell about 650,000 tonnes of grain for subsidised prices in an attempt to stabilise the situation on the grain market. The government also intends to start regulating grain prices on the market and to provide about 600 million crowns from next year's state budget to subsidise prices.
PRAVDA - Higher grain prices are expected to result in a 16 to 19 percent increase in prices of flour, bread, meat, milk and eggs, in 1997.
